messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PAGER fired: high 5xx error rate in eu-west1 (inference-gateway). Threshold breached: 5m error-rate > 5%. PD: P1.

pagerbot: PagerDuty alert created -> PD incident INC-481209. Escalation chain: eng-sre -> eng-runtime -> product-ops.

oncall-sam: acked. I'm on it. folks — what's the customer impact? any big customers hitting this?

maya: seeing 5xx rate jump from ~0.3% to ~9% in last 4m for /v1/generate calls. Primary errors are 502/504 from gateway. Some spikes align with auth-proxy 502s.

lee: +1 on auth-proxy correlation. k8s events show `10s` bursts of `upstream reset` from sidecar to backend pool.

oncall-sam: pulling logs + metrics. maya, can you run `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` for eu-west1 and tail the gateway logs?

maya: running now. snippet: ```
# tail -n 200 -f gateway.log | grep "5.."
2026-03-15T01:22:11Z ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream reset
2026-03-15T01:22:12Z ERROR request_id=abc125 upstream reset
2026-03-15T01:22:14Z ERROR request_id=abc129 connection refused
```

ops-automation: Observed a concurrent surge in small requests from canary-client (~12% of traffic) which has higher connection churn. Might be triggering upstream conn limits.

oncall-sam: thanks. let's throttle canary-client via routing rules. maya — can you add a 50% weight reduction to the canary route in eu-west1? If you can't, rollback canary.

maya: applying weight change now. `redwoodctl routing set-weight --cluster eu-west1 --route canary-client --weight 0.5`

statuspage-bot: Draft status update prepared: "Investigating increased error rates for text generation in eu-west1; mitigations in progress." Want me to publish?

oncall-sam: wait until we confirm impact reduction.

lee: also bumping TCP keepalive on sidecars to reduce upstream resets while we stabilize. patch pushed to staging, rolling to eu-west1 now.

pagerbot: PD note: oncall-sam is primary, maya is backup. INC-481209 assigned.

oncall-sam: updated routing weight is live. monitoring. initial metric: 5xx dropped from 9% -> 4.2% over 2m.

maya: logs show auth-proxy still throwing occasional 502s but rate trending down.

ops-automation: auto-scaler flagged high process restarts on a small subset of backend pods (3/120). I'm launching a rolling-restart of those pods: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-backend -n inference --field-selector metadata.name in (inference-backend-47,inference-backend-52,inference-backend-89)`

lee: restarting helped reduce error bursts on those nodes. connection counts back to normal.

oncall-sam: good. let's hold for 10m observation. If stable, we'll close PD and publish status. If it reoccurs, escalate to infra for kernel tuning (net.core.somaxconn) and LB conn limits.

maya: quick note — some customers reported degraded responses (latency + errors) between 01:20-01:28 UTC. I ran a sample log search, found ~120 affected requests with `request_id` list. I'll upload to the incident doc.

pagerbot: PD INC-481209 -> status: acknowledged -> work in progress. Reminder: update PD timeline every 15m.

incident-bot: Runbook suggested steps executed: 1) reduce canary weight, 2) restart unhealthy pods, 3) bump keepalive. Marking runbook step 1/3 -> 3/3 in progress.

oncall-sam: customers impacted: 3 enterprise customers had requests time out (support tickets opened). Maya — coordinate with CS for inbound tickets, prepare a short note for them.

maya: pinged @cs-ops with request ids and timeframe. I'll draft the customer message: short, apology, mitigation steps, ETA for followup.

ops-automation: metric snapshot: pre-mitigation (01:18): 5xx=8.9%, error volume 3.2k/min. post-mitigation (01:26): 5xx=1.8%, error volume 640/min.

oncall-sam: that's promising. i'll keep PD open until stable for 30m. if <1% 5xx and no customer escalations, we'll resolve.

lee: CI noted a recent LB config change pushed 02:00 UTC earlier today to increase conn draining time; not likely related but keeping in mind.

maya: heads-up — we saw a small uptick in retry traffic (clients doubling requests) which amplified the auth-proxy load. ops-automation recommends bumping rate-limit for canary client temporarily while we fix origin.

oncall-sam: do it. set `rate-limit` bucket to 20rpm for canary-client.

maya: applied, confirmed.

statuspage-bot: Suggested status: "Mitigation in progress — errors reduced. Partial customer impact still possible. Engineers investigating root cause." Approve to publish?

oncall-sam: publish now.

statuspage-bot: Published update to status.redwood.ai (Incident INC-481209)

pagerbot: quick housekeeping: add postmortem lead (lee), timeline owner (maya), severity reviewer (sam).

incident-bot: Reminder: attach logs + sample request ids to PD incident and set label `auto-pager:5xx-spike`

maya: attaching logs & chart snippets to INC-481209.

oncall-sam: 15m check — 5xx steady ~0.9% last 5m. No new customer tickets. I'm going to hand this to daytime rotation in 30m. I'll update PD with handoff note.

lee: will own postmortem. initial hypothesis: auth-proxy conn churn + canary traffic pattern + client retries. We'll validate.

oncall-sam: resolving immediate pager: will remain in PD as active until daytime oncall confirms. If anyone sees regression, ping PD or this thread. great work team :thumbsup:

pagerbot: PD INC-481209 -> status: monitoring -> next update scheduled 01:56 UTC.

statuspage-bot: Final published update: "Issue mitigated — error rates back to normal. Full postmortem forthcoming."

oncall-sam: closing slack thread for now, will reopen if anything flares. Thanks all.
